field: GF(2^8) with reduction polynomial 0x11D (x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1)

generator_matrix_construction.bottom_submatrix: Cauchy C_{p,j} = 1 / (x_p ^ y_j) where x_p = p, y_j = m + j

nomenclatural_resolution.historical_discrepancy: Phase 4.4 documentation occasionally referenced Vandermonde submatrices, whereas the underlying source in src/coding/reed_solomon.rs has always systematically constructed a Cauchy generator matrix.
nomenclatural_resolution.resolution: Cauchy matrices strictly guarantee the MDS property over GF(2^8), whereas standard Vandermonde matrices frequently contain singular square submatrices. The Cauchy implementation is sound, durable, and preserved without breaking changes.
